sentences.en: Having made all the preparations, he set out for Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 做好了一切准备，他出发去了东京。

sentences.en: She was cleaning the house in preparation for a party.
sentences.zh: 她正在打扫房子，为晚上的聚会做准备。

sentences.en: We have to finish preparations for the party by tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在明天之前完成派对的准备工作。
